weather_report:
As dawn gently nudges the city awake, Boston finds itself wrapped in a soft embrace of clouds, the morning air echoing with the promise of autumn. The day unfolds under a mostly cloudy sky, delicate shades of gray brushing against the horizon, hinting at the warmth to come. With temperatures expected to rise to a pleasant 74 degrees, the scene is set for a balmy day, though the whisper of a southwest wind carries the crispness of fall, urging residents to step outside with a light jacket or sweater. 

The approaching evening looms with the possibility of rain, drizzles that might dampen the streets but are unlikely to mar the spirit of the day. As night lingers closer, clouds may escort patchy fog, painting a dreamy picture of twilight—the perfect backdrop for a soothing stroll along the Charles River or a contemplative sip of tea at an inviting café. Layers will serve well, an ensemble to brave both warmth and the subtle chill that lingers in the air. So, as you traverse this dynamic tapestry of the weather, let the splendor of an autumn day and the scent of rain—a sweet harbinger of change—guide your plans. Perhaps an afternoon visit to a local market or a leisurely walk through the fall-colored parks might just be the antidote to the more predictable weekend routines.
